description: Use this when the user wants a new Sessionplan for a workshop, training, meeting, event, or other timed session, or a revised link after decoding an existing Sessionplan. Pass a complete session object matching inputSchema; partial updates and patches are not accepted. The returned structuredContent.link is an opaque snapshot URL and must be presented verbatim.

color.description: CSS color, commonly a hexadecimal color such as #2C8DFE.

id.description: Non-empty identifier, unique within this collection.

date.description: Optional calendar date of this day (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit in days[0].

description.description: Optional description or facilitator notes for this day. Omit in days[0]; the first day's description stays in workshop.description.

durationLocked.description: Whether this day's target duration is locked. Omit in days[0].

items.description: Ordered top-level blocks, groups or breakouts of this day. Omit in days[0].

startTime.description: Optional local start time of this day (HH:MM). Omit in days[0].

targetDuration.description: Optional target duration of this day in minutes. Omit in days[0].

title.description: Optional day label, e.g. 'Kick-off'. Defaults to 'Day n' when omitted.

blockTypeId.description: ID of a declared block type, or null.

children.description: Groups contain blocks or breakouts; breakouts contain blocks. Blocks cannot have children.

duration.description: Explicit section duration in minutes. Groups normally use the sum of children; breakouts use the longest lane. The encoder does not recalculate durations.

durationLocked.description: Preserve the explicit container duration when the editor recalculates the plan.

id.description: Non-empty stable identifier, unique across the complete item tree.

laneIndex.description: Zero-based lane index within the parent breakout; defaults to 0. Must be less than the parent lane count.

lanePersons.description: Map of zero-based lane indices to arrays of declared person IDs. Keep this as a JSON object, including when empty.

lanes.description: Number of breakout lanes, from 1 to 10 as supported by the editor. Defaults to 2 when omitted.

parallel.description: Whether a breakout runs in parallel. Use true for breakouts.

personIds.description: IDs of declared persons assigned to this item.

sameInAllBreakouts.description: Show lane-zero content in every lane; child laneIndex must then be zero or omitted.

type.description: Item kind: block, sequential group, or parallel breakout.

color.description: CSS color, commonly a hexadecimal color such as #2C8DFE.

id.description: Non-empty identifier, unique within this collection.

date.description: Optional calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use null when no date is planned.

durationLocked.description: Whether the target duration is locked.

lastModified.description: Optional timestamp with T separator, seconds 00–59 and a time zone (Z or ±HH:MM), e.g. 2026-09-15T09:00:00.000Z.

startTime.description: Optional local start time (HH:MM, 00:00–23:59). Use null when no start time is planned.

targetDuration.description: Optional target duration in minutes, greater than or equal to zero.

session.description: Canonical format for newly generated Sessionplan documents. Include all required fields and only documented properties. Use declared category/person IDs and the supported item hierarchy.

blockTypes.description: Declared block categories referenced by blockTypeId.

days.description: Optional, only for plans spanning several days. Omit it for single-day plans. days[0] describes the first day and contains only id and optional title; the first day's items, description, date, startTime and target stay in 'items' and 'workshop'. Every further entry is a complete day with its own items. Item IDs must be unique across all days, and all days together may contain at most 500 items.

items.description: Ordered top-level blocks, groups or breakouts. The complete tree may contain at most 500 items.

persons.description: Declared facilitators or participants referenced by personIds and lanePersons.

version.description: Document format version, currently 1.0; distinct from the v2 link codec and MCP protocol version.

session.title: Sessionplan document

name: create_session_link

link.description: Opaque, directly openable Sessionplan snapshot URL. Present this exact value verbatim; do not reconstruct, normalize, shorten, decode, or modify it.

summary.description: Optional compact summary of the encoded session.

blockCount.description: Number of block items across the complete tree; containers are excluded.

totalDuration.description: Sum of explicit top-level item durations in minutes; does not include fixed-start gaps or recalculate children.

title: Create Sessionplan
